dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: My oh my, I really wonder what they like to eat. What shall I use as feed this time?

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: Ah, hello! It's been a while. Would you like to have some tea?

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: Ah, I see you heard me mumbling to myself...

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: Actually, I've been trying to raise Breacher Primuses recently, so I've been making plans to get acquainted with them — on friendly terms, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: Well then, guess I won't keep you. But if you've got the time and mind to, just stop by for a cup of hot tea.

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: Well, they are gentle and cute little things — isn't it just like how humans own pets?

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: Sometimes, I feel my spirits lifted just from watching them walk around.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you need any help preparing any feed?

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: Thanks for the kind offer, but I haven't used up all the current feed I'm using. I'm just wondering what I should use next.

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: They might suffer from unbalanced nutrition if they always eat only one thing, so I need to switch recipes frequently...

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: By the way, what do you think would make the best feed? Tidalga membrane, Beryl Conch organs, or dried Lumitoile skin?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are any of those nutritious in the first place...?

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: Uh, to be honest, I'm not sure either, but they might be nutritious to the Breacher Primuses, considering how happily they eat the stuff?

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: But if none of those options work, I might have to come up with something else...
